newsitem.title: UK: Abbey National slips, Lehman stays cautious.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National slips, Lehman stays cautious.

text.p: Shares in Abbey National Plc fell on Monday as analysts at Lehman Brothers repeated their cautious stance on the stock.
The shares were off 7-1/2p at 748p by 1154 GMT.
"We have confirmed our view on Abbey," said Ian McEwan, banking analyst at Lehman Brothers. "It remains an underperformer."
McEwan commented that Abbey shares look overvalued considering the pressure on the group's core mortgage and savings business.

"With Abbey it is a balancing act," the analyst said. "We think the pressure on the mortgage and savings business is pretty stiff and the rate at which they can organically increase value in the rest of the group is relatively slow in comparison....so the net story is a poor one"
